const (
	ChunkText         ChunkKind = "text"
	ChunkToolCall     ChunkKind = "tool_call"
	ChunkUsage        ChunkKind = "usage"
	ChunkFinish       ChunkKind = "finish"
	ChunkContentBlock ChunkKind = "content_block"
	ChunkReasoning    ChunkKind = "reasoning"
)

const (
	ContentText          ContentKind = "text"
	ContentToolCall      ContentKind = "tool_call"
	ContentToolResult    ContentKind = "tool_result"
	ContentReference     ContentKind = "reference"
	ContentReasoning     ContentKind = "reasoning"
	ContentProviderState ContentKind = "provider_state"
	ContentRefusal       ContentKind = "refusal"
	ContentImage         ContentKind = "image"
	ContentAudio         ContentKind = "audio"
	ContentVideo         ContentKind = "video"
)

const (
	ReasoningNone    ReasoningEffort = "none"
	ReasoningMinimal ReasoningEffort = "minimal"
	ReasoningLow     ReasoningEffort = "low"
	ReasoningMedium  ReasoningEffort = "medium"
	ReasoningHigh    ReasoningEffort = "high"
	ReasoningXHigh   ReasoningEffort = "xhigh"
	ReasoningMax     ReasoningEffort = "max"
)

const (
	RoleSystem    Role = "system"
	RoleUser      Role = "user"
	RoleAssistant Role = "assistant"
	RoleTool      Role = "tool"
)

const MaxStreamContentBlocks = 4096

const MaxStreamContentIndex = 1 << 20

func (accumulator *StreamAccumulator) Finish() (Message, error)

func (accumulator *StreamAccumulator) Push(chunk StreamChunk) (err error)

func (accumulator *StreamAccumulator) Snapshot() Message

func (audio Audio) Validate() error

func (b ContentBlock) Validate() error

func (config ModelConfig) AllowsTool(name string) bool

func (config ModelConfig) Validate() error

func (effort ReasoningEffort) SuggestedTokenBudget() (uint32, bool)

func (image Image) Validate() error

func (m Message) Text() string

func (m Message) Validate() error

func (payload MediaPayload) Validate() error

func (reference Reference) Validate() error

func (state ProviderState) Validate() error

func (video Video) Validate() error

func CloneContent(content []ContentBlock) []ContentBlock

func CloneMessages(messages []Message) []Message

func CloneModelConfig(config ModelConfig) ModelConfig

func CloneStreamChunk(chunk StreamChunk) StreamChunk

func CloneToolCall(call ToolCall) ToolCall

func CloneUsage(usage Usage) Usage

func NewStreamAccumulator(maxBytes int) *StreamAccumulator

func ParseReasoningEffort(value string) (ReasoningEffort, error)

func TextMessage(role Role, text string) Message

func ValidJSON(data json.RawMessage) bool

import "encoding/json"

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/url"
	"strings"
)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"math"
	"strings"
)

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

type Audio struct {
	Payload        MediaPayload `json:"payload"`
	DurationMillis int64        `json:"duration_millis,omitempty"`
	Transcript     string       `json:"transcript,omitempty"`
}

type ChunkKind string

type ContentBlock struct {
	Kind          ContentKind    `json:"kind"`
	Text          string         `json:"text,omitempty"`
	ToolCall      *ToolCall      `json:"tool_call,omitempty"`
	ToolResult    *ToolResult    `json:"tool_result,omitempty"`
	Reference     *Reference     `json:"reference,omitempty"`
	Reasoning     *Reasoning     `json:"reasoning,omitempty"`
	ProviderState *ProviderState `json:"provider_state,omitempty"`
	Refusal       *Refusal       `json:"refusal,omitempty"`
	Image         *Image         `json:"image,omitempty"`
	Audio         *Audio         `json:"audio,omitempty"`
	Video         *Video         `json:"video,omitempty"`
}

type ContentKind string

type Image struct {
	Payload MediaPayload `json:"payload"`
	Detail  string       `json:"detail,omitempty"`
	Width   int          `json:"width,omitempty"`
	Height  int          `json:"height,omitempty"`
}

type MediaOperation struct {
	Kind             string          `json:"kind"`
	Description      string          `json:"description"`
	InputSHA256      string          `json:"input_sha256,omitempty"`
	OutputSHA256     string          `json:"output_sha256,omitempty"`
	FrameTimesMillis []int64         `json:"frame_times_millis,omitempty"`
	Parameters       json.RawMessage `json:"parameters,omitempty"`
}

type MediaPayload struct {
	MediaType  string           `json:"media_type"`
	Data       []byte           `json:"data,omitempty"`
	URL        string           `json:"url,omitempty"`
	Provenance *MediaProvenance `json:"provenance,omitempty"`
}

type MediaProvenance struct {
	Original    Reference        `json:"original"`
	Operations  []MediaOperation `json:"operations,omitempty"`
	Description string           `json:"description"`
}

type Message struct {
	ID           string         `json:"id,omitempty"`
	Role         Role           `json:"role"`
	Content      []ContentBlock `json:"content"`
	Usage        *Usage         `json:"usage,omitempty"`
	ResponseID   string         `json:"response_id,omitempty"`
	FinishReason string         `json:"finish_reason,omitempty"`
}

type ModelConfig struct {
	Temperature     *float64         `json:"temperature,omitempty"`
	MaxTokens       *uint32          `json:"max_tokens,omitempty"`
	StopSequences   []string         `json:"stop_sequences,omitempty"`
	TopP            *float64         `json:"top_p,omitempty"`
	ReasoningEffort *ReasoningEffort `json:"reasoning_effort,omitempty"`
	ExtraBody       json.RawMessage  `json:"extra_body,omitempty"`
	DisableTools    bool             `json:"disable_tools,omitempty"`

	AllowedTools        []string `json:"allowed_tools"`
	TurnSystemAdditions []string `json:"turn_system_additions,omitempty"`
}

type ProviderState struct {
	Provider   string          `json:"provider"`
	ToolCallID string          `json:"tool_call_id,omitempty"`
	Data       json.RawMessage `json:"data"`
}

type Reasoning struct {
	Text         string `json:"text,omitempty"`
	Signature    string `json:"signature,omitempty"`
	RedactedData string `json:"redacted_data,omitempty"`
}

type ReasoningEffort string

type Reference struct {
	URI        string `json:"uri"`
	MediaType  string `json:"media_type,omitempty"`
	SHA256     string `json:"sha256,omitempty"`
	Bytes      int64  `json:"bytes,omitempty"`
	Processing string `json:"processing,omitempty"`
}

type Refusal struct {
	Text string `json:"text"`
}

type Role string

type StreamAccumulator struct {
}

type StreamChunk struct {
	Kind ChunkKind

	ContentIndex *int
	Text         string
	ToolCall     *ToolCall
	Usage        *Usage
	FinishReason string
	ContentBlock *ContentBlock
	ResponseID   string
}

type ToolCall struct {
	ID            string          `json:"id"`
	Name          string          `json:"name"`
	Arguments     json.RawMessage `json:"arguments"`
	ProviderState []ProviderState `json:"provider_state,omitempty"`
}

type ToolDefinition struct {
	Name        string          `json:"name"`
	Description string          `json:"description"`
	Parameters  json.RawMessage `json:"parameters"`
}

type ToolResult struct {
	CallID  string         `json:"call_id"`
	Content []ContentBlock `json:"content"`
	IsError bool           `json:"is_error,omitempty"`
}

type Usage struct {
	InputTokens  uint64 `json:"input_tokens"`
	OutputTokens uint64 `json:"output_tokens"`

	CachedInputTokens     *uint64 `json:"cached_input_tokens,omitempty"`
	TotalTokens           uint64  `json:"total_tokens,omitempty"`
	CacheWriteInputTokens *uint64 `json:"cache_write_input_tokens,omitempty"`
	ReasoningTokens       uint64  `json:"reasoning_tokens,omitempty"`
}

type Video struct {
	Payload        *MediaPayload `json:"payload,omitempty"`
	DurationMillis int64         `json:"duration_millis,omitempty"`
	Frames         []VideoFrame  `json:"frames,omitempty"`
}

type VideoFrame struct {
	TimestampMillis int64 `json:"timestamp_millis"`
	Image           Image `json:"image"`
}
